summary: Built and calibrated a reproducible exact A6 oracle; classified the nondegenerate momentum walls and candidate-pole orbits; verified removable behavior at representatives of both triple-pole orbits; and exactly ruled out the symmetry-complete singleton/doubleton truncated-power H1 basis. No compact closed formula was obtained.
work_done: Copied and rebuilt bg.cpp under bots/student-1/code and reproduced the A5 calibrations exactly.
Generated 225 exact generic A6 samples plus two-sided wall and pole approaches.
Reduced the nondegenerate subset-momentum walls to 18 labeled walls in two symmetry orbits.
Tested all four internal-subset composition orbits and found the two pair cases degenerate-only and both tested triple cases removable.
Constructed 8- and 16-feature symmetry-invariant box-spline bases and proved exact rank inconsistency.
Ran py_compile and the complete bots/student-1/code/run_pipeline.sh entry point successfully.
next_steps: Determine the invariant that maps the full physical domain to the stated eight baseline words; the momentum-wall signatures alone give three observed S3xS3 orbits.
Seek a compact building block outside H1, likely incorporating a different symmetric threshold or cancellation construction.
Prove removability along the complete triple factorization surfaces rather than at one isolated representative per orbit.
